arxiv-2111-05437.title: Inequitable Access to EV Charging Infrastructure
arxiv-2111-05437.creator: Hafiz Anwar Ullah Khan, Sara Price, Charalampos Avraam, Yury Dvorkin
arxiv-2111-05437.description: Abstract Access to and affordability of electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure are the two prominent barriers for EV adoption. While major efforts are underway in the United States to roll-out public EV charging infrastructure, persistent social disparities in EV adoption call for interventions.

arxiv-2204-13097.title: Learning to Borrow – Relation Representation for Without-Mention Entity-Pairs for Knowledge Graph Completion
arxiv-2204-13097.creator: Huda Hakami, Mona Hakami, Angrosh Mandya, Danushka Bollegala
arxiv-2204-13097.description: Abstract Prior work on integrating text corpora with knowledge graphs (KGs) to improve Knowledge Graph Embedding (KGE) have obtained good performance for entities that co-occur in sentences in text corpora. Such sentences (textual mentions of entity-pairs) are represented as Lexicalised Dependency Paths (LDPs) between two entities.

arxiv-2206-01711.title: Entropy and entanglement in a bipartite quasi-Hermitian system and its Hermitian counterparts
arxiv-2206-01711.creator: Abed Alsalam Abu Moise Graham Cox Marco Merkli
arxiv-2206-01711.description: Abstract We consider a quantum oscillator coupled to a bath of N N other oscillators. The total system evolves with a quasi-Hermitian Hamiltonian. Associated to it is a family of Hermitian systems, parameterized by a unitary map W W .

arxiv-2307-11527.title: A multiparameter Stochastic Sewing lemma and the regularity of local times associated to Gaussian sheets Thanks: MSC 2020: 60H50; 60H15; 60L90 Acknowledgment: FB acknowledges support through the Bielefeld Young Researchers Fund that enabled a research visit. HK acknowledges funding by DFG through IR
arxiv-2307-11527.creator: Florian Bechtold and Fabian A. Harang and Hannes Kern
arxiv-2307-11527.description: Abstract . We establish a multiparameter extension of the stochastic sewing lemma [ Lê20 ] . This allows us to derive novel regularity estimates on the local time of locally non-deterministic Gaussian fields. These estimates are sufficiently strong to derive regularization by noise results for SDEs in the plain by leveraging the results from [ BHR23 ] .

arxiv-2308-07729.title: Decay rates for mild solutions of QGE with critical fractional dissipation in L 2 ​ ( ℝ 2 ) L^{2}(\mathbb{R}^{2})
arxiv-2308-07729.creator: Jamel Benameur
arxiv-2308-07729.description: Abstract In [ 2 ] the authors proved some asymptotic results for the global solution of critical Quasi-geostrophic equation with a condition on the decay of θ 0 ^ \widehat{\theta_{0}} near at zero. In this paper, we prove that this condition is not necessary. Fourier analysis and standard techniques are used. Keywords . Quasi-geostrophic equation, asymptotic study, Gevrey-Sobolev spaces.

arxiv-2501-06310.title: Bordered algebras and the wrapped Fukaya category
arxiv-2501-06310.creator: Isabella Khan
arxiv-2501-06310.description: Abstract . This paper establishes an isomorphism between endomorphism algebras from the wrapped Fukaya category of a type of punctured surface, and the class of 𝒜 ∞ \mathcal{A}_{\infty} -algebras related to bordered knot Floer homology, called star algebras , which the author first constructed in [ 9 ] .

arxiv-2512-06530.title: On The Role of K-Space Acquisition in MRI Reconstruction Domain-Generalization
arxiv-2512-06530.creator: Mohammed Wattad, Tamir Shor, and Alex Bronstein
arxiv-2512-06530.description: Abstract Recent work has established learned k-space acquisition patterns as a promising direction for improving reconstruction quality in accelerated Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI). Despite encouraging results, most existing research focuses on acquisition patterns optimized for a single dataset or modality, with limited consideration of their transferability across imaging domains.

europmc-pmc5408814.title: Calypso: a user-friendly web-server for mining and visualizing microbiome-environment interactions.
europmc-pmc5408814.creator: Zakrzewski M, Proietti C, Ellis JJ, Hasan S, Brion MJ, Berger B, Krause L.
europmc-pmc5408814.description: Calypso is an easy-to-use online software suite that allows non-expert users to mine, interpret and compare taxonomic information from metagenomic or 16S rDNA datasets. Calypso has a focus on multivariate statistical approaches that can identify complex environment-microbiome...

openalex-w7214241759.title: ASSISTÊNCIA ESTUDANTIL E PERMANÊNCIA NA EDUCAÇÃO SUPERIOR: CONTRIBUIÇÕES DO APOIO PSICOLÓGICO PARA O BEM-ESTAR E A TRAJETÓRIA ACADÊMICA
openalex-w7214241759.creator: Janaina Silva Oliveira, Cleiliany Oliveira Santos de Araújo
openalex-w7214241759.source: OpenAlex / Revista Ibero-Americana de Humanidades, Ciências e Educação
openalex-w7214241759.description: Este artigo buscou revisar as contribuições do apoio psicológico oferecido no âmbito da assistência estudantil para o bem-estar e a permanência dos estudantes na educação superior pública brasileira. Considerando a expansão do acesso à universidade e as vulnerabilidades...

pmc-11390490.title: Niche partitioning and host specialisation in fish‐parasitising isopods: Trait‐dependent patterns from three ecosystems on the east coast of India
pmc-11390490.creator: Sandeep Kumar Mohapatra, Anshuman Swain, Dipanjan Ray, Rajesh Kumar Behera, Basudev Tripathy, Jaya Kishor Seth, Anil Mohapatra
pmc-11390490.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Due to their large size and obligate nature, Cymothoid isopods inflict a high degree of tissue damage to fish. Still, they are understudied at an ecosystem level despite their global presence and ecological role. In this work, we collected fish host‐isopod parasite data, along with their life history and ecological traits, from the northern part of the east coast of India and investigated patterns in host specialisation and preference of isopod parasites using a trait‐based network perspective.

pmc-11547867.title: Fabrication of Rapidly Soluble Zn2+-Releasing Phosphate-Based Glass and Its Incorporation into Dental Resin
pmc-11547867.creator: Fan Deng, Haruaki Kitagawa, Tomoki Kohno, Tingyi Wu, Naoya Funayama, Pasiree Thongthai, Hefei Li, Gabriela L. Abe, Ranna Kitagawa, Jun-Ichi Sasaki, Satoshi Imazato
pmc-11547867.description: Phosphate-based glasses are known for their excellent biocompatibility and adjustable degradation rates. In this study, we fabricated a rapidly soluble zinc-ion-releasing phosphate-based glass (RG) specifically designed for use in dental cavity liners. The aim of this study was to evaluate the ion-releasing properties and antibacterial effects of RG.

pmc-11586392.title: Descriptive analysis of incidence, demographic characteristics, and survival outcomes of soft-tissue sarcoma of the extremities in Saudi Arabia
pmc-11586392.creator: Wazzan Aljuhani, Abdullah Alanazi, Eyad Alshehri, Mohammed K Alageel, Emad Masuadi, Mostafa Zolaly, Abdulrahman Bobsait
pmc-11586392.description: Soft-tissue sarcomas are uncommon, aggressive, and histologically heterogeneous, malignant tumors. Soft-tissue tumor types have different age and anatomical site distributions. This study aimed to assess the prevalence and incidence of soft-tissue sarcomas of the extremities to facilitate early diagnosis and intervention in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

pmc-11620722.title: Technical and Analytical Approach for Breast Reconstruction With IMAP Propeller Flap
pmc-11620722.creator: Antonio Spaggiari, Wayne A. Morrison, Caterina Marra, Irene Laura Lusetti, Federica Fiocchi, Massimo Pinelli, Giorgio De Santis
pmc-11620722.description: Background:The breast-sharing technique uses the lower quadrants discarded from a contralateral symmetrizing reduction mammoplasty to reconstruct the breast after mastectomy. The aim of our study was to revisit this old technique and to improve its vascular predictability by preoperative computed tomography angiography (angio-CT) and intraoperative indocyanine green (ICG) imaging.

pmc-11682946.title: Lethal disruption of the bacterial gut community in Eastern subterranean termite caused by boric acid
pmc-11682946.creator: Aaron R Ashbrook, Melbert Schwarz, Coby Schal, Aram Mikaelyan, Claudia Husseneder
pmc-11682946.description: The Eastern subterranean termite, Reticulitermes flavipes (Kollar) (Blattodea: Rhinotermitidae), is a significant pest, causing extensive damage to structures that amount to substantial economic losses. Boric acid is widely used for wood preservation due to its stability and broad-spectrum insecticidal properties, yet its impact on termite gut microbiomes and the implications of such effects remain understudied.

pmc-11704891.title: A Comprehensive Review of the Physical Examination for the Biceps-Labrum Complex of the Shoulder
pmc-11704891.creator: Matthew R. Bryan, Alex E. White, Paul M. Inclan, Stephen J. O’Brien, Samuel A. Taylor
pmc-11704891.description: Biceps-labrum complex (BLC) disease is a well-established pain generator in the shoulder. Despite its ubiquity, BLC disease continues to pose a diagnostic challenge for orthopaedic surgeons. The use of magnetic resonance imaging and glenohumeral arthroscopy in the diagnosis of BLC disease has proven to be inadequate when performed independently.

pmc-12747538.title: Cultivar‐specific preference of bacterial communities and host immune receptor kinase modulate the outcomes of rice–microbiota interactions
pmc-12747538.creator: Jiwei Xu, Peiyao Hu, Meng Liu, Wanyuan Zhang, Kabin Xie
pmc-12747538.description: Deciphering how plant–microbiota interactions achieve beneficial outcomes for crops will provide innovative strategies for sustainable agriculture. Here, we dissected rice‐microbiota dynamics using a tailored gnotobiotic cultivation system that models the semiaquatic environment in a paddy field. Inoculation with native soil microbiota resulted in root‐growth‐promotion (RGP) and root‐growth‐inhibition (RGI) phenomena in different cultivars.

pmc-13096976.title: Incidence, Mortality, and Federal Research Funding by Cancer Type in the US
pmc-13096976.creator: Chirayu Mohindroo, Anish Thomas
pmc-13096976.description: This cross-sectional study examines the association between disease burden and US federal funding of cancer research in fiscal year 2025. Introduction Both cancer outcomes and the distribution of federal research funding across cancer types continue to evolve. Federal funding reflects a combination of peer-reviewed scientific opportunity, historical investment, and congressional appropriations.

pmc-13119743.title: Washability and Electrical Performance Evaluation of Jacquard Conductive Knitted Fabrics Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Assessment
pmc-13119743.creator: Su Liu, Wei Wang, Hui Yang, Jun Wu
pmc-13119743.description: This study presents a systematic evaluation of 2-layer conductive Jacquard knitted fabrics with a birdseye backing designed for wearable electronic applications. Three sets of samples with 9 different proportions of conductive yarn (27 samples) are designed on a computerized flat-knitting machine, and three indicators (conductive yarn usage ratio, resistance change ratio after washing, and temperature variation) are examined.

pmc-13236789.title: Partially mixed ration silages based on banana leaves, with and without tomato residue, in the diet of lambs under semi-arid conditions
pmc-13236789.creator: Adson Moreira Silva, Alisson Samuel Portes Caldeira, João Paulo Sampaio Rigueira, Loren Ketlyn Fernandes Vieira, Virgílio Mesquita Gomes, Rogério Mendes Murta, Laura Lúcia dos Santos Oliveira, Fredson Vieira e Silva
pmc-13236789.description: This study evaluated partially mixed ration (PMR) silages based on banana leaves alone (BL-PMR) or combined with tomato agro-industrial residue (BLTR-PMR) in diets of lambs managed under semi-arid conditions. Twenty-seven female lambs were assigned to three treatments during a 52-day trial (12 days adaptation; 40 days data collection): control (concentrate), BL-PMR, or BLTR-PMR.

pmc-13332478.title: Contextualizing the adolescent social brain: Links to social health using data from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study
pmc-13332478.creator: Myles N. Arrington, Johnna R. Swartz, Jeffrey R. Fine, Amanda E. Guyer

pmc-13531895.title: Thiostrepton potentiates chemotherapy-induced cell death in cisplatin-resistant SKOV3 cells
pmc-13531895.creator: Farzaneh Motafeghi, Ehsan Ghassemi Barghi, Jafar Gholami Gharab, Parham Mortazavi, Fahimeh Ramezani Tehrani, Sorour Ashari, Nasrin Ghassemi Barghi

pmc-13646423.title: Considering the assessment of survivability and preventability following mass fatality incidents: Where are we and where do we need to go?
pmc-13646423.creator: Carl Evans, Benjamin Swift, Amy Hughes, Gareth Grier, Claire Park
pmc-13646423.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Following a mass fatality incident, the assessment of survivability and preventability is essential, yet current methodologies remain inconsistent both within the UK and internationally. The 2024 UK Home Office report ‘The Patronising Disposition of Unaccountable Power: Independent Review of Forensic Pathology’ evaluated learning from the Hillsborough disaster and the Manchester Arena bombing inquests, highlighting the urgent need for clearer, standardised processes in determining survivability and preventability.
